name: User Registration & Login – Magic Links & Email OTP Verification, Passkeys & 2FA, Cloudflare Turnstile, Google reCAPTCHA & Honeypot – HMDIA
author: hmdia-team

sections.description:
HMDIA Login & Registration helps you create a sign-in and account experience that fits your site. Design login, registration, password reset and account pages; customize forms and emails; and verify new users with an email code or magic link. Built-in spam protection, optional CAPTCHA, redirects and page access controls give you more control while using WordPress user accounts.

The free plugin works on its own. Optional Pro adds advanced login and registration fields, two-factor authentication, passkeys and session tools. Separate add-ons extend traffic security, content submission and support.

Free features

  • Custom login, registration, password reset and account pages.
  • Centralized form design templates with form selection and live previews.
  • Customizable email templates, branding, previews and test emails.
  • Registration email verification using one-time codes or magic links.
  • Administrator approval for new registrations.
  • Configurable password requirements.
  • Terms & Conditions acceptance on registration forms.
  • Redirect the default WordPress login page.
  • Custom redirects after login, registration and logout.
  • Restrict selected pages by login status and user role.
  • Hide the WordPress admin bar and restrict dashboard access by role.
  • Frontend profile editing and password management.
  • Built-in honeypot protection, Google reCAPTCHA v3 and Cloudflare Turnstile.
  • Contact forms with configurable fields, saved submissions and email notifications.
  • Contact phone fields with country flags, dialing codes and a configurable default country.
    Explore all the features.

Pro features

  • Passwordless passkey login, passkey two-factor verification and recovery codes.
  • Two-factor authentication using an authenticator app, email, or SMS.
  • Google Sign-In for login and registration.
  • Temporary Login Access.
  • Advanced session management for Admin & Users.
  • Force User Logout
  • Role-based redirects.
  • Advanced login and registration fields.
  • Additional account and registration options.

Optional add-ons

  • Traffic & IP Security: visitor analytics, sign-in activity and IP rules.
  • User Post Submission: frontend content-submission forms.
  • WooCommerce Verification: customize checkout fields and verify customers using email codes, SMS codes, or both.

External services

  • Google reCAPTCHA v3: Optional spam checks send visitor IP and browser data to Google; verification also sends the challenge token and secret key. Service · Terms · Privacy
  • Cloudflare Turnstile: Optional spam checks send visitor IP and browser data to Cloudflare; verification also sends the challenge token and secret key. Service · Terms · Privacy
  • Twilio SMS (optional Pro add-on): When enabled, SMS delivery sends phone numbers, security-code messages and credentials to Twilio. Connection tests send credentials; SMS may incur charges. Service · Terms · Privacy
    CAPTCHA may also run for suspicious sign-ins when the optional Traffic & IP Security add-on is configured.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate HMDIA Login & Registration in WordPress.
  2. Use the optional Setup Wizard or configure pages and forms in the plugin settings.
  3. If purchased, install and activate the separate Pro add-on after Core.
    Documentation.
sections.faq:
What does HMDIA Login & Registration replace?

It provides customizable frontend login, registration, password reset and account pages while continuing to use WordPress user accounts and authentication. You can optionally redirect the default WordPress login page to your custom login page.

Can I customize the forms and emails?

Yes. You can customize form fields, labels, buttons, colors, spacing and authentication email content to match your website.

Do I need Pro to use the plugin?

No. The free plugin works independently and includes custom forms, registration verification, email customization, spam protection and contact forms. Pro adds features such as passkeys, two-factor authentication, Google Sign-In and advanced session management.

Can existing WordPress users sign in?

Yes. Existing WordPress users can sign in using their current account credentials. Their accounts remain stored and managed in WordPress.

Do I need CAPTCHA keys?

No. The built-in honeypot works without API keys. Google reCAPTCHA v3 and Cloudflare Turnstile are optional and require their respective site and secret keys when enabled.

Why am I not receiving verification emails?

Email delivery depends on your website’s mail configuration. Check the spam or junk folder, run an email delivery test in the plugin settings, and review your WordPress mail or SMTP configuration.

Can I verify email addresses and phone numbers at WooCommerce checkout?

Yes. The separate HMDIA WooCommerce Verification add-on supports email codes, SMS codes, or both at checkout. It requires WooCommerce, a compatible Core version and an active HMDIA Pro entitlement. Customers must complete each enabled verification method before checkout can proceed.

Does uninstall delete my users or data?

Uninstall cleanup is opt-in. Regular WordPress users are preserved. Separately enabling page cleanup can move verified plugin-created pages to Trash; deactivation does not delete them.
sections.changelog:
2.1.5

  • Add dedicated Account design templates with styling managed in the Design tab.
  • Fix two-column contact form layouts in desktop previews.
  • Simplify design settings and improve checkbox and radio styling for custom registration fields.

2.1.4

  • Add Passkey as an optional default sign-in method (Pro).
  • Add country flags, dialing codes and a Default country setting to contact form phone fields.
  • Simplify form design navigation and labels.

2.1.3

  • Improve form styling compatibility with themes and other plugins.
  • Improve registration approval and rejection handling.
  • Improve contact-form success and error messages.

2.1.2

  • Improve password-manager recognition with explicit sign-in form metadata and associated login field labels while preserving existing passkey autofill hints.
  • Mark offscreen anti-spam inputs as hidden to prevent incorrect password-manager form classification.
  • Fix first-attempt CAPTCHA connection tests in settings and the setup wizard when the provider API loads slowly.

2.1.1

  • Show active 2FA method counts and a searchable user sidebar when supported by Pro.
  • Confirm disabling site-wide 2FA when users have active methods; preserve their saved methods.
  • Protect users from losing their only usable individual 2FA method and retain locked values during saves.

2.1.0

  • Add support for Google Sign-In on login and registration forms (Pro).
  • Add support for passwordless passkey login (Pro).
  • Improve sign-in buttons and settings layout.

2.0.90

  • Fixed an issue that prevented the Save button from appearing after editing Design Templates.

2.0.89

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
  • Explain when a security plugin blocks the new session after a password change; discard the rejected session token.
